summary: The EU sets the common framework for generational renewal in farming: the CAP interventions for young farmers, the Strategy for Generational Renewal in Agriculture and the EU CAP Network's knowledge on the topic. Aid is implemented nationally and regionally.

coverage.note: Review of the European Commission's generational renewal and young farmers pages and the EU CAP Network topic page. EU funding instruments managed by the EIB and national implementations are not listed individually.

resources.name: Strategy for Generational Renewal in Agriculture
resources.whatItOffers: EU policy framework to make farming more accessible: support for starting, fairer and more transparent land markets, earlier farm succession and pension security, training and rural services.
resources.whoCanUseIt: Member States designing their measures; young farmers and new entrants as the target group.

sources.title: Generational renewal in agriculture
quotes: The Strategy for Generational Renewal in Agriculture sets out a comprehensive policy framework
Access to land remains one of the biggest barriers for new entrants
Creating a European Land Observatory to improve transparency on land use, ownership and prices

resources.notes: The European Land Observatory is a measure of the Strategy; it is not recorded as an operating service.

resources.name: CAP 2023-27 support for young farmers
resources.whatItOffers: Explains the CAP interventions for young farmers that every country tailors in its CAP Strategic Plan: complementary income support, installation aid, investment support and cooperation for farm succession.
resources.whoCanUseIt: Young farmers apply through their national or regional CAP authorities, not at EU level.
resources.howToAccess: Check the national or regional implementation of the CAP Strategic Plan.

sources.title: Young farmers
quotes: The CAP 2023-27 provides for several interventions specifically for young farmers
EU countries must dedicate an amount corresponding to at least 3% of their direct payments budget to support young farmers
in the context of farm succession, this applies in particular for generational renewal at farm level

resources.name: EU CAP Network — Generational Renewal
resources.whatItOffers: European knowledge hub on measures, projects, publications and good practices that support young farmers and new entrants.

sources.title: Generational Renewal | EU CAP Network
quotes: Find out more about measures, projects and training to stimulate generational renewal and support young farmers and new entrants

resources.name: European Observatory on Farmland
resources.whatItOffers: Planned EU observatory to improve transparency on farmland markets and access to land. In 2026 the Commission launched a call for an Expert Group on Farmland that prepares it, alongside a pilot project.

sources.title: Access to land
quotes: a European Land Observatory to improve transparency, monitor market developments and support informed policymaking
In 2026, a call to set up a new expert group on Farmland was launched
This group will serve as an essential precursor to the European Observatory on Farmland

resources.notes: Not operating yet: the Commission describes it as a future observatory prepared by an expert group and a pilot project.

limitations: No EU-level event of 2026 that changes the instruments available to farmers was verified for this edition.
EU pages describe frameworks; eligibility and application routes are set by each country or region.
